# kindofui

> 145 live UI and UX patterns. Each one has when to use it, when it hurts, what it is based on or where it is seen, a ready prompt for AI assistants, and copyable HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Build 1012.

Read these files instead of scraping the page. Every pattern has its own Markdown page with the full prompt and code.

- [All patterns as JSON](https://kindofui.vercel.app/patterns.json): every pattern with its facts, prompt and code, plus the decision guides, the UX audit and the Compare screens
- [Which should I use?](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/decisions.md): 11 decision guides, for example modal vs drawer vs toast, spinner vs skeleton vs last known value, when to show form errors
- [UX audit checklist](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/ux-audit.md): 26 checks to review an interface, each linked to its pattern

## Visual styles

- [Bento grid](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/bento.md): Rounded tiles of different sizes packed into one grid.
- [Glassmorphism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/glass.md): Frosted, semi-transparent panels that blur what sits behind them, with a thin light border.
- [Neumorphism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/neu.md): Elements look pushed out of, or pressed into, the same-colored surface using one light and one dark shadow.
- [Minimalism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/minimal.md): Lots of white space, one or two colors and only the elements the task needs.
- [Material Design](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/material.md): Google's system: layered surfaces with elevation shadows, a top app bar, chips, and a floating action button for the main action.
- [Flat design](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/flat.md): Solid colors, no shadows, no gradients, no textures.
- [Skeuomorphism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/skeuo.md): Digital objects copy real materials: leather, wood, paper, brushed metal.
- [Neo-brutalism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/neobrutal.md): Thick black borders, hard offset shadows with no blur, loud flat colors and chunky type.
- [Brutalism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/brutal.md): Raw, default-browser look: system serif fonts, blue underlined links, plain tables, no polish on purpose.
- [Dark UI](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/darkui.md): Light text on near-black surfaces.
- [Aurora / mesh gradient](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/aurora.md): Large, heavily blurred color blobs that slowly drift behind the content, like northern lights.
- [Claymorphism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/clay.md): Puffy, inflated shapes with big rounded corners, soft outer shadows and inner highlights so they look like soft clay.
- [Retro / Y2K / pixel](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/retro.md): Nostalgic computer looks: beveled grey windows, pixel fonts, blue title bars, chrome and early-2000s colors.
- [Editorial / typography-led](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/editorial.md): Big expressive type carries the design, laid out like a magazine with kickers, bylines, columns and drop caps.
- [Illustration-led](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/illus.md): Custom drawings give the brand its personality and explain the product before the copy does.
- [Swiss / International style](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/swiss.md): A strict grid, sans-serif type, flush-left text, and bold geometric shapes in red, black and white.
- [Memphis](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/memphis.md): 1980s-inspired chaos: squiggles, triangles, dot patterns and clashing bright colors.
- [Cyberpunk / synthwave neon](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/neon.md): Glowing cyan and magenta text on black, neon outlines and a retro perspective grid.
- [Liquid Glass](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/liquidglass.md): Apple's newer take on glass: clear, lens-like controls with bright edge highlights that bend the colors behind them.
- [Vaporwave](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/vaporwave.md): Pink and teal sunsets, striped suns, checkerboard floors, wide-spaced letters and 90s computer nostalgia.
- [Pixel art](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/pixel.md): Chunky square pixels, limited palettes, pixel fonts and stepped button edges, like 8-bit and 16-bit games.
- [Retro-futurism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/retrofuture.md): The future as imagined in the 1950s and 60s: atoms, starbursts, boomerang shapes, cream, orange and teal.
- [3D / hyperrealism](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/threed.md): Objects with real depth, lighting and reflections that tilt as you move.
- [HUD / sci-fi interface](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/hud.md): Thin glowing lines, corner brackets, radar sweeps and monospaced readouts, like a cockpit or a film's computer screen.
- [Spatial UI](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/spatial.md): Floating glass windows placed in a real room, with side "ornaments" for tabs and a grab bar to move the window.
- [Kinetic typography](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/kinetic.md): Type that moves: letters stretch, squash and scroll so the words themselves become the animation.
- [Organic / biophilic](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/organic.md): Soft blob shapes, earthy greens and clay tones, gentle serifs and slow natural movement inspired by plants and nature.
- [Gen Z maximalism / anti-design](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/genz.md): Deliberate chaos: clashing fonts, rotated stickers, starbursts, scrolling strips and loud neon.
- [ASCII / dithering](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/ascii.md): Pictures made of text characters and dot patterns, monospaced type and terminal colors.
- [Bauhaus](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/bauhaus.md): Primary colors, pure circles, squares and triangles, bold sans-serif type and strong asymmetric balance.
- [Art Deco](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/artdeco.md): Gold on deep navy or black, fan and sunburst patterns, double borders, symmetry and tall, elegant capitals.
- [Monochrome](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/monochrome.md): Only black, white and greys.
- [Duotone](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/duotone.md): A photo turned into just two colors, one for shadows and one for highlights, often with bold type on top.
- [Grain / noise texture](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/grain.md): A fine film-like noise over gradients and flat colors.
- [Holographic / iridescent](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/holographic.md): Shifting rainbow pastels with shiny streaks, like a hologram sticker or foil card.
- [E-ink / paper](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/eink.md): Grey paper, black serif text, no color and no animation.
- [Apple HIG (iOS style)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/ios.md): Apple's Human Interface Guidelines: large titles, grouped rounded lists, colored icon squares, chevrons and green switches.
- [Fluent (Windows style)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fluent.md): Microsoft's design system: soft tinted backgrounds, light cards, a blue accent bar on the selected item and rounded toggles.

## Layouts

- [Card layout](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/cards.md): Equal cards in a grid, each a self-contained preview with image, title and key facts.
- [Masonry grid](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/masonry.md): Columns of items with different heights that stack tightly with no gaps, like a brick wall.
- [Dashboard](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/dashboard.md): Sidebar navigation, a top bar with filters, summary numbers first and charts below them.
- [Split screen](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/split.md): Two halves with different jobs: one sells or shows a picture, the other holds the action, often a form.
- [Hero + sections](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/hero.md): The classic landing page: navigation, a big headline with one call to action, then feature blocks as you scroll.
- [Scrollytelling](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/scrolly.md): A visual stays pinned while text scrolls past it, and the visual changes with each step of the story.
- [Asymmetric / broken grid](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/asym.md): Elements overlap, rotate and break out of a regular grid on purpose to feel editorial and dynamic.
- [F-pattern & Z-pattern](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fz.md): How eyes scan a screen.
- [Holy grail layout](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/holygrail.md): Header on top, footer at the bottom, and three columns between them: navigation, main content and a side panel.
- [12-column grid](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/grid12.md): The page is split into 12 equal columns with gutters.
- [List-detail (master-detail)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/listdetail.md): A list on one side and the selected item's full content on the other.
- [Kanban board](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/kanban.md): Columns for each stage of work, with cards that move left to right.
- [Carousel / slider](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/carousel.md): One slide at a time with arrows and dots.
- [Horizontal scroll rows (shelves)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/shelf.md): Rows of items that scroll sideways, one row per category.
- [Timeline](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/timeline.md): Events in order along a line, with done, current and upcoming steps clearly marked.
- [Pricing table](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/pricing.md): Plans side by side with the recommended one raised and highlighted.
- [Parallax scrolling](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/parallax.md): Background layers move slower than the foreground, which creates a feeling of depth.
- [Full-screen sections (scroll snap)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fullscreen.md): Each section fills the screen and scrolling snaps from one to the next, like slides.

## Navigation

- [Top navbar (sticky header)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/stickynav.md): A horizontal menu at the top that stays pinned while the page scrolls under it.
- [Mega menu](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/mega.md): A wide dropdown that shows many grouped links at once, often with a promo tile.
- [Hamburger menu](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/hamburger.md): Three lines that open a hidden menu, saving space on small screens.
- [Bottom tab bar](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/tabbar.md): Three to five main sections pinned to the bottom of a phone screen, within easy reach of the thumb.
- [Sidebar / drawer](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/sidebar.md): A vertical panel on the left listing sections or channels.
- [Command palette](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/cmdk.md): A search box that runs any action by typing.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/crumbs.md): A trail that shows where you are in a hierarchy and lets you jump back up a level.
- [Stepper / wizard](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/stepper.md): Breaks a long task into ordered steps and shows progress.
- [Tabs & segmented control](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/tabs.md): Switch between views of the same thing without leaving the page.
- [Dropdown menu](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/dropdown.md): A button that opens a short list of actions or links, then closes.
- [Fat footer](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fatfooter.md): A large footer with grouped links, a newsletter box and legal info.
- [Navigation rail](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/navrail.md): A slim vertical bar of icons with labels, made for tablets and desktop.
- [Dock](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/dock.md): A row of app icons that grow under the pointer, with dots under running apps.
- [Floating action button (speed dial)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fab.md): One round button for the main action, floating above the content.
- [Table of contents (scroll spy)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/toc.md): A list of the page's sections that highlights where you are as you scroll, and jumps to a section when clicked.
- [Accordion](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/accordion.md): Stacked headers that expand to show their content.
- [Back-to-top button](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/backtotop.md): A small button that appears after you scroll down and takes you back to the top.
- [Back button closes overlays](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/backbutton.md): People expect Back to undo what looks like a new page: a photo opened full screen, a filter, a step.
- [Search-first navigation](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/searchfirst.md): A big search box is the main way to get around, with recent searches and live suggestions.

## Components and UX patterns

- [Microinteractions](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/micro.md): Small animations that confirm an action happened: a heart that pops, a switch that slides, a button that says "Copied".
- [Skeleton loading](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/skeleton.md): Grey shimmering shapes stand in for content while it loads, so the page feels faster and doesn't jump.
- [Last known value (stale-while-revalidate)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/lastknown.md): While fresh data loads, keep showing the data from last time with a small "Updating" note and when it was last updated, then change the numbers in place.
- [Delayed spinner (no flash of loading)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/delayspin.md): Fast requests show no loader at all.
- [Reserve space (no layout shift)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/reserve.md): Give images, ads, banners and anything that loads late a fixed slot, so the page never jumps.
- [Error summary on submit](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/errsummary.md): When a form fails, a box at the top lists every problem, each one a link to its field, and keyboard focus moves to it.
- [Label placement](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/labels.md): Where a field's name lives.
- [Password field done right](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/password.md): Show the rules before people type and tick them off live, offer a show password button, and let paste and password managers work.
- [Double-submit protection](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/doublesubmit.md): Make Pay and Submit safe to click twice: show the pressed state at once, ignore repeat clicks while the request runs, and let the server drop duplicates with an idempotency key.
- [Search as you type, done right](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/debounce.md): Wait for a short pause in typing before searching, and cancel or ignore older requests.
- [Inline message vs toast](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/inlinestatus.md): Put errors and results next to where the person acted, and keep them until they are fixed.
- [Infinite scroll vs pagination](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/infinite.md): Infinite scroll keeps loading as you reach the bottom, good for browsing.
- [Progressive disclosure](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/disclosure.md): Show the few options most people need, and hide the rest behind "Advanced" or "Show more" until someone asks.
- [Empty states & onboarding](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/empty.md): Left: an empty screen that explains what will appear and how to start.
- [Gesture-based UI](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/swipe.md): Swipe, drag, pinch, long-press and pull-to-refresh instead of buttons.
- [Conversational UI](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/chat.md): Users get things done by chatting, with quick-reply buttons for common answers.
- [Modals & toasts](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/modal.md): A modal blocks the page to ask for a decision.
- [Dark patterns](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/darkpat.md): Tricks that push people into choices they didn't intend: fake timers, pre-ticked add-ons, fees revealed late, and guilt-trip opt-out links.
- [Inline form validation](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/validation.md): Fields check themselves as you type and say exactly how to fix the problem, with a live password strength meter.
- [Faceted search & filters](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/facets.md): Checkboxes narrow a list by several attributes at once, with a live result count and removable filter chips.
- [Autocomplete](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/autocomplete.md): Suggestions appear as you type, with the matching letters highlighted and keyboard support.
- [Sortable data table](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/datatable.md): Rows of records with a sticky header.
- [Drag and drop reorder](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/dragdrop.md): Grab a handle and drag items into a new order.
- [Optimistic UI](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/optimistic.md): The change shows up instantly while it saves in the background, and only asks you to retry if saving fails.
- [Notification center](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/notifications.md): A bell with an unread count opens a panel of recent activity.
- [Tooltips & popovers](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/tooltip.md): A tooltip is a short label that appears on hover or focus.
- [Pull to refresh](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/pulltorefresh.md): Drag a list down past the top and let go to load new items, with a spinner while it works.
- [Lazy loading (blur-up)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/lazyload.md): Images load only when they scroll into view, starting as a blurry preview and sharpening when ready.
- [Error states](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/errors.md): Good errors say what happened and how to fix it: a plain 404, an offline notice, an inline field error and a failed-payment message with a way to retry.
- [Loaders & progress](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/loaders.md): Spinners for short unknown waits, progress bars and rings when you know how far along it is, and buttons that show they're working.
- [Login & OTP verification](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/auth.md): One-time code boxes that jump to the next box as you type and accept a pasted code, plus passwordless options.
- [Settings page](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/settings.md): Preferences grouped under clear headings, with switches that act right away and risky actions set apart in a danger zone.
- [Ratings & reviews](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/ratings.md): An average score, a breakdown bar for each star level, and a star input that previews on hover.
- [Live collaboration](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/collab.md): See who else is here: avatar stack, named cursors, other people's selections and typing carets, all updating live.

## AI patterns

- [Prompt box](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/promptbox.md): A roomy input that grows with your text, holds attachments, shows the model or mode, and only enables Send when there's something to send.
- [Streaming response](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/streaming.md): The answer appears word by word so people can start reading at once, with a Stop button while it writes.
- [Suggested prompts](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/suggestions.md): Starter cards on an empty screen show what the AI can do and fill the input in one tap.
- [Inline citations](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/citations.md): Numbered markers link each claim to its source, with a preview card so people can check the answer.
- [Voice & multimodal input](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/voice.md): A mic button with a live waveform and transcript, so people can see they're being heard.

## UX laws

- [Fitts's law](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fitts.md): The bigger and closer a target is, the faster people can hit it.
- [Hick's law](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/hick.md): The more choices people see at once, the longer they take to decide.
- [Jakob's law](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/jakob.md): People spend most of their time on other sites, so they expect yours to work the same way.
- [Miller's law (chunking)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/miller.md): Short-term memory holds only a handful of items, often given as 7 ± 2.
- [Gestalt principles](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/gestalt.md): How the eye groups things: by closeness, by similar looks, by filling gaps, and by shared containers.
- [Von Restorff effect](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/vonrestorff.md): The item that looks different from the rest is the one people remember and notice first.
- [Tesler's law](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/tesler.md): Every task has some complexity that can't be removed.
- [Doherty threshold](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/doherty.md): People stay engaged when the system responds in under about 400 ms.
- [Aesthetic-usability effect](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/aesthetic.md): People think good-looking designs are easier to use, and forgive small problems in them.
- [Nielsen's 10 heuristics](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/nielsen.md): Jakob Nielsen's ten rules of thumb for usable interfaces.

## Accessibility and motion

- [Accessibility-first (WCAG)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/a11y.md): Design so everyone can use it, including people with low vision, motor issues or screen readers: enough contrast, big targets, real labels and keyboard focus.
- [WCAG POUR principles](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/pour.md): The four principles the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines are built on.
- [Color-blind safe design](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/colorblind.md): About 1 in 12 men has some color blindness.
- [Visible focus states](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/focus.md): Keyboard users need to see where they are.
- [Focus after actions](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/focusafter.md): After a delete, a closed dialog or a new view, put keyboard focus somewhere sensible: the next item, or the button that opened the dialog.
- [Semantic HTML & ARIA](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/aria.md): Use real buttons, labels and alt text so screen readers can announce what things are.
- [Reduced motion](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/reducedmotion.md): Some people get dizzy or sick from movement.
- [Easing curves](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/easing.md): Easing controls how motion speeds up and slows down.
- [Page transitions](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/transitions.md): Motion between screens shows where you came from and where you went.

## Process and methods

- [Mobile-first & responsive](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/responsive.md): Design for the smallest screen first, then let the same content reflow into more columns as space grows.
- [Design systems](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/designsystem.md): A shared library of tokens (colors, type, spacing) and components so every screen looks and behaves the same.
- [Atomic design](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/atomic.md): Build UIs from the smallest parts upward: atoms (a button) make molecules (a search field), which make organisms (a header), then templates and real pages.
- [Human-centered design process](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/hcd.md): Start from real users, not assumptions.
- [HCI: Human-Computer Interaction](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/hci.md): HCI studies how people perceive, think and act when they use computers.
- [User persona](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/persona.md): A short profile of a typical user, built from research, with goals, frustrations and context.
- [Customer journey map](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/journey.md): The stages a person goes through, what they do and feel at each one, where it hurts, and ideas to fix it.
- [Card sorting](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/cardsort.md): Users sort topics into groups that make sense to them, which shows how to structure menus and categories.
- [Information architecture (sitemap)](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/ia.md): A map of every page and how it's grouped, planned before any visual design so people can find things.
- [Wireframe vs mockup vs prototype](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/fidelity.md): Three levels of detail.
- [A/B testing](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/abtest.md): Show two versions to similar groups of real users and keep the one that performs better, only once the result is statistically reliable.
- [Design tokens](https://kindofui.vercel.app/p/tokens.md): Named values for color, radius, type and spacing that components read from.
